boundary: Read-only observations of primary scientific publications and author-owned repositories. Not acquired source registrations, immutable repository snapshots, or method admission.

records.finding: CUT&RUN introduces a targeted in situ nuclease-release sequencing workflow and reports yeast/human experiments.
Observed peak-calling and spike-in calibration scripts; repository presence supports an analysis-source role, not a replacement for the experimental Methods.

inspected_sections: Methods: DNA library preparation, sequencing and data analysis
records.finding: Tn5-059 reduces GC insertion bias; inspected genome-library comparisons use standard Nextera workflow. Assay-level novelty beyond the reagent is not established by this limited review.
SHARE-seq abstract explicitly develops a same-cell joint assay despite a biological/computational paper title.
Protein-production and optimized low-input library reaction claims coexist; retain focused assay-level scope/version review.
Official vignette describes aligned fragments/annotations as inputs and bias-corrected accessibility deviations as analysis output, consistent with software-only intake.
Repository links the method preprint and contains protocol.png plus analysis folders; preserve distinct source roles and publication version.
Matched biological atlas uses previously described fast-ATAC and low-input RNA profiling.
